writeup.title: fix(stock): prevent race conditions and release holds on failed payments
writeup.summary: This branch replaces separate stock checks and updates with a single conditional UPDATE statement to prevent race conditions during checkout. It also ensures that failed or errored payments immediately release stock holds instead of waiting for expiration.
changes: Replaced read-then-write stock reservation with a single conditional UPDATE using `try_reserve`.
Released stock holds immediately when an order payment fails or encounters a gateway error.
Updated tests to verify immediate stock release on failed/errored payments and updated metric assertions.

functions.what_it_does: Releases order stock holds, marks the order as payment failed, and records a failed payment attempt.
Attempts to hold inventory units in a single conditional update statement, returning True if successful.
Reserves stock for each line of an order using try_reserve and creates reservation entries.
Releases all active reservation entries for an order unless the reservation leak fault is enabled.

writeup.release_note: Fixed stock race conditions during simultaneous checkouts and ensured failed payments release held stock immediately.
